{{Short description|Estonian politician and chemist}}

'''Aime Sügis''' (born 21 January 1935, in [[Tallinn]]) is an [[Estonia]]n chemist and politician. She was a member of [[VII Riigikogu]].<ref name="Toomla, 1999">{{cite book |last1=Toomla |first1=Jaan |title=Valitud ja valitsenud: Eesti Parlamentaarsete ja muude esinduskogude ja valitsuste isikkoosseis aastail 1917–1999 |date=1999 |publisher=[[Estonian National Library]] |location=Tallinn |isbn=9985921720 |page=408 |url=https://www.digar.ee/viewer/et/nlib-digar:288727/264611/page/410 |access-date=6 March 2021 |language=Estonian}}</ref>
